chapters.reason: The paper introduces RWKV-5 and RWKV-6, which are defined by matrix-valued hidden states and predetermined update rules, fitting the definition of linear-state recurrence.
The architecture is designed to maintain the inference efficiency of RNNs while replacing traditional self-attention with sub-quadratic mixers, aligning with the goal of hidden-state conversion.
The paper demonstrates the practical application and competitive performance of these recurrent models across a wide variety of benchmarks.
